razonamiento: The architecture shows SonarCloud's Autoscan pipeline and Compute Engine. Developers push code to GitHub, triggering an AWS Lambda function that triages and puts an analysis request into SQS. An ECS Fargate cluster pulls the queue, clones code from GitHub, performs the analysis, and pushes reports via an API to an EC2 instance. EC2 stores the reports in Amazon Aurora. A second ECS Fargate cluster (Compute Engine) extracts reports from Aurora, computes metrics, writes updates back to Aurora, and stores search-optimized data in an in-house Elasticsearch cluster. Finally, developers query the EC2 API/UI to view the results.
